caption: The drawing depicts a single hand tool positioned horizontally on a plain, light beige background. The tool consists of a long, slightly curved metal blade with a rusty brown color and visible roofing, connecting two rounded, elongated wooden handles. Each handle is vertically aligned and attached to either end of the blade, showing brown coloration with darker wood grain patterns. The overall composition centers the object with no additional elements, text, or embellishments other than the minimal labels beneath and to the bottom right of the drawing, which appear in small, light, grayish text.
title: Drawknife
